title: Exact integer expression evaluator with power, unary minus and truncating division
why_hard: Small positive cases pass with almost any parser, but the spec fixes semantics that differ from habit: right-associative ^, unary minus looser than ^ yet allowed right after ^, no unary plus, and C-style truncating / and % on arbitrary-size integers, where the usual int(a / b) goes through a float and is wrong (or overflows) on big numbers while Python's // and % floor instead of truncating.
